from pathlib import Path
import base64,hashlib,importlib.machinery,json,os,struct,subprocess,sys
R=Path.cwd();O=R/'.tools/review7-request-path-originals';O.mkdir(exist_ok=False);sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'tests/semantics'));import static_types as t
observer=importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('request_path_observer',str(R/'bin/php-semantics')).load_module()
source=b'<?php echo $_SERVER["PHP_SELF"],":",$_SERVER["SCRIPT_NAME"],":",$_SERVER["SCRIPT_FILENAME"],":",$_SERVER["PATH_TRANSLATED"],":",$argv[0],":",__FILE__,":",__DIR__;echo $missing;'
p=O/'real.php';p.write_bytes(source);(O/'alias.php').symlink_to('real.php');entries=[b'LC_ALL=C',b'TZ=UTC'];packet=b'PHPRQ001'+struct.pack('<qII',1700000000,125000,len(entries))+b''.join(struct.pack('<I',len(e))+e for e in entries);rows=[]
def enc(b):return base64.b64encode(b).decode()
f=t.Worker([str(t.PHP),'-n',*t.FLAGS,'-d','extension='+str(R/'.tools/php-file.so'),str(R/'frontend/worker.php')]);a=t.Worker([str(R/'.tools/request-adapter-first/main.exe'),str(R/'.tools/request-adapter-first/root')])
try:
 parsed=f.request({'op':'parse','source':enc(source)});assert parsed['accepted']
 for spelling in ['real.php','alias.php']:
  payload=O/(spelling+'.input');payload.write_bytes(packet);cmd=[str(t.PHP),'-n',*t.FLAGS,spelling,'alpha']
  with payload.open('rb') as stream:
   os.dup2(stream.fileno(),198)
   try:native=subprocess.run(cmd,env={'LD_PRELOAD':str(R/'.tools/request-clock.so')},pass_fds=(198,),cwd=O,capture_output=True,timeout=15)
   finally:os.close(198)
  request={'op':'execute','ast':parsed['ast'],'steps':10000,'filename':enc(str(p).encode()),'request':{'env':[[enc(b'LC_ALL'),enc(b'C')],[enc(b'TZ'),enc(b'UTC')]],'argv':[enc(spelling.encode()),enc(b'alpha')],'file':enc(spelling.encode()),'seconds':'1700000000','microseconds':125000,'variables':enc(b'EGPCS'),'jit':True}};response=a.request(request);actual=observer.observe(response['state'],str(p));oracle={'stdout':enc(native.stdout),'stderr':enc(native.stderr),'exit_status':native.returncode};row={'id':spelling,'source_base64':enc(source),'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),'command':cmd,'cwd':str(O),'filename':str(p),'request':request,'payload_base64':enc(packet),'oracle':oracle,'response':response,'actual':actual,'agrees':actual['status']=='normal' and all(actual[k]==v for k,v in oracle.items())};rows.append(row);(O/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps({'records':rows},indent=2)+'\n');print(spelling,native.stdout,native.stderr,row['agrees'],flush=True);assert row['agrees']
finally:f.close();a.close()
